Microneedling with Dermapen

Microneedling uses ultra-fine needles to make tiny, controlled channels in your skin. Your skin heals them by making fresh collagen, which smooths acne scars, tightens open pores, softens fine lines and evens out tone. With no heat involved, it's one of the safest skin treatments for Indian skin.

Treatment overview

What is Microneedling?

Microneedling, also called collagen induction therapy, is a simple idea that works. A pen-like device with very fine needles moves over your skin and creates thousands of tiny, controlled punctures. They are too small to scar, but big enough to tell your skin to repair itself.

As the skin heals, it builds new collagen and elastin. Over the following weeks, that fresh collagen fills in scars, firms the skin around pores and softens lines. Because there is no heat, it suits Indian and darker skin tones especially well.

Read more: why the device matters

Not all microneedling is the same. A professional device makes a big difference to safety and results:

  • Straight, precise needles go in and out vertically instead of dragging like a roller.
  • Adjustable depth lets the doctor treat thin under-eye skin and thick scars differently.
  • Sterile, single-use cartridges for every client.
  • Serums go deeper through the fresh channels, so PRP, exosomes or brightening serums work harder.

Read more about how microneedling rejuvenates and brightens skin.

1. Micro-channelsFine needles create thousands of tiny, controlled punctures.
2. Healing responseYour skin rushes to repair them within hours.
3. New collagenFresh collagen builds for months, smoothing and firming.

Our technology

Why We Use Dermapen 4

The device decides how precise, comfortable and effective your microneedling is. Here's what Dermapen 4 brings.

Dermapen 4 Microneedling

Dermapen 4 is an advanced, motorised microneedling pen. Its needles move straight in and out at high speed, so channels are clean and even, with less trauma to the skin than a roller. Your doctor sets the exact depth for every area, from the delicate under-eyes to deep acne scars, and it includes a dedicated setting for scar revision.

Precise depth controlDedicated scar settingSingle-use cartridgesNo heatAll skin types
Faster healingClean vertical channels heal quickly
Even resultsConsistent depth across the face
ComfortableSmooth, vibration-free gliding
VersatileFace, neck, under-eyes and body

Boost your results

Platelet-rich plasma from your own blood is full of growth factors. Applied during microneedling, it speeds up healing and boosts collagen, especially for acne scars and under-eyes.

  • Faster healing
  • Stronger collagen boost
  • Great for scars and under-eyes
Best for: acne scars, under-eyes, stretch marks
Extra time: about 20 minutes
About PRP face treatment

Lab-made exosomes carry repair signals to your skin cells. Added after microneedling, they calm redness and help skin heal and glow faster, with no blood draw.

  • Less redness afterwards
  • Faster recovery
  • Extra glow and hydration
Best for: glow, fine lines, sensitive skin
Blood draw: not needed
About exosome treatment

PDRN (salmon DNA) supports skin repair and elasticity. With microneedling it helps improve skin quality, firmness and fine lines.

  • Supports repair
  • Improves elasticity
  • Smoother, healthier skin
Best for: skin quality, fine lines, under-eyes
About PDRN

If you need stronger tightening or have deep scars or very large pores, MNRF adds radiofrequency heat through the needles for a more powerful collagen boost.

  • Stronger skin tightening
  • Better for deep scars
  • Slightly more downtime
Best for: deep scars, loose skin, large pores

What to expect

Benefits of Microneedling

One treatment that helps scars, pores, lines and tone, using your skin's own healing power.

Smoother Acne Scars

Breaks up old scar tissue and builds fresh collagen to lift rolling and boxcar scars.

Tighter-looking Pores

Softer Fine Lines

More Even Tone

Faded Stretch Marks

Improves the texture and colour of stretch marks on the body.

Better Skincare Absorption

Safe for Indian Skin

Quick Recovery

Skin Problems Microneedling Can Treat

Tap a concern to see how microneedling helps, what we pair it with and how many sessions you may need.

Acne scars

Acne can leave behind rolling, boxcar or ice-pick scars. Microneedling makes thousands of tiny, controlled punctures that break up stiff scar tissue and wake up your skin's healing response. Over a few months, new collagen fills in and lifts the scars.

  • Lifts rolling and boxcar scars
  • Fades post-acne marks
  • Safe on darker skin

Acne scar treatment

Open, enlarged pores

Pores look bigger when the skin around them loses firmness. Microneedling builds fresh collagen around each pore so it looks tighter and the skin surface looks smoother.

  • Smaller-looking pores
  • Smoother texture
  • Less oiliness over time

Fine lines & wrinkles

From our late 20s, collagen slowly drops and lines start to appear. Microneedling stimulates collagen and elastin, thickening the skin so fine lines soften and skin feels firmer.

  • Firmer, thicker skin

Pigmentation & dark marks

Because microneedling uses no heat, it's a safer way to treat pigmentation on Indian skin than many lasers. It renews the skin and helps brightening serums work deeper.

  • Fades dark marks

Old breakouts, sun and age leave skin bumpy and uneven. Regular microneedling smooths the surface and gives skin a soft, polished look.

Stretch marks

Stretch marks form when the skin's support fibres tear during pregnancy, growth spurts or weight changes. Body microneedling rebuilds collagen inside the marks, so they become flatter and less noticeable.

  • Colour closer to your skin
  • Works on tummy, thighs, hips and arms

Thin, crepey under-eye skin

The skin under the eyes is very thin, so lines and shadows show easily. Gentle, shallow microneedling thickens this skin over a few sessions, softening crepiness and fine lines.

Your appointment

Microneedling Procedure: Step by Step

A little preparation helps you heal faster and get better results.

  • Your doctor examines your skin and agrees a plan with you.
  • Stop retinoids, glycolic or salicylic acid and scrubs 5 to 7 days before.
  • Avoid sun and tanning for 2 weeks before.
  • Tell us if you get cold sores, as you may need antiviral tablets.
  • Drink plenty of water and keep your skin moisturised.
  • Come with clean skin, without makeup.

A session takes 45 to 60 minutes, including numbing.

  • Your skin is cleansed and disinfected.
  • Numbing cream is applied for 30 to 45 minutes.
  • A serum, PRP or exosomes is spread over the skin.
  • The doctor glides the Dermapen over each area at the right depth.
  • A soothing serum or mask calms the skin.
  • Sunscreen is applied before you leave.

Your skin will look like it has a mild sunburn for a day or two. The full aftercare plan is below.

  • Redness and warmth for 1 to 3 days.
  • Skin may feel tight, dry or slightly rough.
  • Light flaking around days 3 to 5.
  • Don't wash your face for 6 to 8 hours.
  • No makeup for 24 hours.
  • No gym, sauna or swimming for 48 hours.

Recovery & results

Microneedling Results Timeline

Microneedling works with your skin's natural healing, so results keep building for months.

  1. Day 1–2

    Pink & warm

    Skin looks and feels like a mild sunburn.

  2. Day 3–7

    Fresh & smooth

    Any flaking settles and skin looks brighter.

  3. Weeks 4–6

    Collagen builds

    Pores, lines and texture start to visibly improve.

  4. After 3–6 sessions

    Lasting change

    Scars are shallower and skin is firmer. Results keep improving for 3 to 6 months.

A good fit if you

  • Have acne scars or post-acne marks
  • Have open pores or uneven texture
  • Want to soften early lines
  • Want a treatment that's safe for Indian skin

Wait if you have

  • Active acne or skin infection
  • Active cold sores or eczema on the area
  • Taken isotretinoin in the last 6 months
  • A tendency to form keloids

Aftercare

Microneedling Aftercare

Gentle aftercare helps your skin heal quickly and protects your results.

Do

  • Leave the serum on for 6 to 8 hours
  • Wash gently with cool water and a mild cleanser
  • Use only the moisturiser you're given
  • Sleep on a clean pillowcase

Avoid

  • Makeup for 24 hours
  • Gym, sauna, steam and swimming
  • Direct sun
  • Touching or scratching your face

Do

  • Use SPF 30 to 50 every day
  • Keep skin well moisturised
  • Let any flakes fall off on their own
  • Drink plenty of water

Avoid

  • Retinoids and acids for 5 to 7 days
  • Scrubs and face brushes
  • Waxing or threading the area
  • Picking at dry skin

Morning

  • Gentle cleanser
  • Vitamin C or hydrating serum
  • Moisturiser
  • Sunscreen, reapplied outdoors

Night

  • Gentle cleanser
  • Treatment cream your doctor suggests
  • Barrier-repair moisturiser
  • Next session in 4 to 6 weeks

Your skin type

Microneedling for Every Skin Type

Indian and darker skin tones
One of the safest collagen treatments for darker skin, because there's no heat. We still choose the depth carefully and insist on sunscreen to keep pigmentation risk low.
Oily, acne-prone skin
Great for scars and pores once breakouts are under control. We don't needle over active, inflamed pimples.
Sensitive skin
We use shallower depths and calming serums or exosomes, and build up slowly.
Dry skin
Microneedling with hydrating serums or PRP can leave dry skin plumper and more comfortable.
Mature skin
Excellent for fine lines and firmness. For deeper wrinkles or sagging, we may suggest MNRF, skin boosters or HIFU.

Safety first

Microneedling Side Effects and Who Should Wait

Done properly, microneedling is very safe. Here's what's normal and when it's better to wait.

Common and temporary

  • Redness and warmth for 1 to 3 days
  • Mild swelling, especially under the eyes
  • Tightness, dryness or light flaking
  • Tiny pinpoint marks that fade in a day or two
  • Small breakouts as skin settles (uncommon)

Talk to your doctor first if you

  • Are pregnant or breastfeeding
  • Have active acne, infection, cold sores or eczema
  • Have taken isotretinoin in the last 6 months
  • Have a bleeding disorder or take blood thinners
  • Tend to form keloids or raised scars

Questions

Microneedling FAQs

Does microneedling hurt?
We apply a numbing cream for 30 to 45 minutes first, so most people feel only light pressure, vibration or a mild scratching sensation. Bony areas like the forehead can feel a little more.
How many sessions will I need?
For glow and fine lines, 3 sessions usually make a clear difference. Acne scars and stretch marks often need 4 to 6. Sessions are spaced 4 to 6 weeks apart so collagen has time to build.
What is the downtime?
Expect redness like a mild sunburn for 1 to 2 days after a medium session, and 2 to 3 days after deeper scar work. Light flaking may follow. Most people return to work the next day.
When will I see results?
Skin looks fresher and glowier within a week. Collagen keeps building for 3 to 6 months, so scars, pores and lines keep improving long after each session.
Is microneedling safe for Indian skin?
Yes. Microneedling uses no heat or light, so the risk of pigmentation is much lower than with many lasers. We still adjust the depth carefully and ask you to protect your skin from the sun.
What is Dermapen 4?
Dermapen 4 is a professional, motorised microneedling device. It uses a sterile, single-use needle cartridge and lets the doctor set the exact needle depth for each area, from very shallow under the eyes to deeper on scars.
Is clinic microneedling better than a derma roller at home?
Yes. A clinic device like Dermapen goes in straight and at a precise depth, with sterile single-use needles. Home rollers drag across the skin, can tear it, are hard to keep sterile and can't reach the depth needed for scars.
Microneedling or MNRF: which should I choose?
Microneedling is gentler, more affordable and great for glow, pores, fine lines and mild to moderate scars. MNRF adds radiofrequency heat for stronger tightening and deeper scars. Your doctor will suggest the right one for you.
Can I combine microneedling with PRP or exosomes?
Yes, and it often gives better results. PRP and exosomes help the skin heal faster and build more collagen. Ask about our combination packages.
Can I do microneedling if I have active acne?
Not over active, inflamed pimples, as needling can spread bacteria. We first calm active acne with peels or medication, then treat the scars.
Can I wear makeup after microneedling?
Wait at least 24 hours, and ideally until redness settles. Makeup on freshly treated skin can clog the tiny channels and cause irritation.
Where can I get microneedling in Kerala?

How much does microneedling cost?
It depends on the area, the number of sessions and whether you add PRP, exosomes or PDRN. Our 3 and 6-session courses offer the best value. Book a consultation for a personalised quote.
